notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.60

• The Dynamic Island is gone, and with it its always-on notification.
• 'Crash detection is on' no longer sits in your notifications — crash detection still runs, quietly.
• Settings › DuckCloud now has DuckConnections (was 'DuckOS PCs' on the Settings home): sign in a DuckOS PC with this phone, lock it or sign it out. Scanning a sign-in code still takes you straight there.
